items.h: Jason Myers a Strong Play in Week 8
items.s: Seattle Seahawks kicker Jason Myers should be a strong play in Week 8 against the Chicago Bears. Myers is the K8 heading into this game. He has been a consistent producer in the seven- to eight-point range in fantasy. Myers' superpower has been his accuracy. He has only missed two total kicks this season, and the Seahawks have been kicking more field goals in recent weeks, leading to more fantasy points for Myers. No matter what, the Seahawks should be in scoring position plenty of times throughout this game. Chicago does not boast an elite defense, and it should take newly acquired defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons a few weeks to get up to speed and make a marked impact. As such, you can…

items.h: Jason Myers makes two FGs in Week 7
items.s: Jason Myers made both of his field-goal attempts and added two extra points in a 20-3 win over the Chiefs in Week 7. Myers hit field goals from 25 and 35 yards out in the win over the previously undefeated Chiefs. The veteran kicker has now hit 14 of his 15 attempts on the year. He will take on the Bears in Week 8.

items.h: Coverts two field goals in win
items.s: Myers went 2-for-2 on field-goal tries and made both of his PATs during Sunday night's 20-3 win over the Chiefs. Myers was able to make multiple field goals for the third straight game, converting a 25-yarder in the second quarter before later adding a 35-yard make in the second half. The kicker has now gone 14-for-15 on field-goal tries, including 3-for-3 from 50-plus yards, over the first seven games of the 2026 campaign.

items.h: Jason Myers in For Another Solid Week
items.s: Seattle Seahawks kicker Jason Myers will look to deliver another solid fantasy week in Week 7 against the Kansas City Chiefs. Myers missed his first field goal of the season in Week 6 against the Denver Broncos. Otherwise, he has been incredibly accurate this year. What is more, Myers has now attempted at least three field goals in two straight games. That is more in line with his field goal volume from 2025, which has resulted in better fantasy days. So far this season, Myers' floor has been five fantasy points, with a ceiling exceeding 20 points. The Chiefs' defense presents a tough matchup for Seattle's offense, but this team should still find itself in scoring position relatively…

items.h: Jason Myers has big miss in loss to Denver
items.s: Jason Myers hit two of three field goal attempts in the Seahawks' 17-14 loss to the Broncos on Thursday. He did not attempt a PAT. Meyers had a miss in the third quarter that ended up being crucial in the game, as the game went to overtime tied 14-14. Had Meyers connected, it's entirely possible the Seahawks pull off the low-scoring win. However, history is history, and the only thing he can do is move on.

items.h: Critical miss in overtime loss
items.s: Myers went 2-for-3 on field-goal attempts during the Seahawks' 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos on Thursday. Myers opened Thursday's scoring with a 55-yard field goal late in the first quarter, with the veteran kicker taking advantage of the altitude at Mile High Stadium. He missed a 47-yarder in the third quarter but made up for it with a 34-yard field goal within the final seconds of the fourth, which forced Thursday's game into overtime. It was the first missed field goal of the season for Myers, who is 12-for-13 on field-goal attempts (including 3-for-3 on kicks from 50-plus yards) and 14-for-15 on PATs through six regular-season games. The Seahawks will head back home for a Week 7…

items.h: Jason Myers a Quality Kicker Option in Week 6
items.s: Seattle Seahawks kicker Jason Myers is a great option in Week 6 against the Denver Broncos. Myers is coming off a 23-point game in which he made all five of his field goal attempts. The knock on Myers this season had been a lack of field goal attempts, but that was sure to change at some point, and it appears to have reverted to the mean. Myers also continues to be very accurate this season. He has only missed one kick: an extra point against the Chargers in Week 4. With the Seahawks' offense often finding itself in scoring position, Myers is always a threat for double-digit fantasy points. The Broncos boast a quality defense, but it is nothing Seattle's offense cannot handle. Look for…

items.h: Nails five field goals, two PATs vs. Niners
items.s: Myers made all seven of his kicks (five field goals, two extra points) during the Seahawks' 32-29 loss to the 49ers on Sunday. Myers was responsible for 17 of the Seahawks' 29 points during Sunday's loss. All five of his field goals came from 40-plus yards and included a 50-yard make late in the second quarter to reduce Seattle's deficit to 14-13. Myers' five field goals in Week 5 were as many as he made through the first four games of the regular season and his most in a game since Week 15 of the 2025 campaign against the Colts (six). The Seahawks are on a short week as they travel to Denver for Thursday Night Football against the Broncos, whose defense could be without starting outside…

items.h: Jason Myers has big day Sunday
items.s: Jason Myers connected on 5-of-5 field goals and 2-of-2 extra point attempts on Sunday. The Seahawks struggled to put the ball in the end zone on Sunday, which Myers took advantage of. He is now 10-of-10 on field goal attempts on the season.

items.h: Jason Myers a Top-10 Kicking Option in Week 5
items.s: Seattle Seahawks kicker Jason Myers has been a relatively safe option in 2026. He has made all of his kicks except for one extra point attempt in Week 4. Myers should continue to deliver in Week 5 against the San Francisco 49ers. Given that he is attached to a high-powered offense in Seattle, Myers should be in scoring position consistently. His biggest shortcoming in 2026 has been his lack of field goal attempts. He has attempted one field goal in every game but one this season. Seattle has been relatively efficient as an offense, scoring touchdowns rather than settling for field goals. The 49ers present Seattle's toughest challenge yet, and this defense could force the Seahawks into more…

items.h: Jason Myers makes lone field goal Sunday
items.s: Jason Myers made his lone field goal attempt and 3-of-4 extra point attempts on Sunday. Myers made his lone field goal from 35 yards out. He missed a 53-yard field goal earlier in the drive, but a leverage penalty on the Chargers gave the Seahawks an automatic first down.

items.h: Myers made his only field-goal try and went 3-for-4 on extra-point attempts during Sunday's 30-23 win against the Chargers.
items.s: Myers nailed his only field-goal attempt of the day, converting a 35-yard try late in the third quarter. The kicker has now gone three straight games without making multiple field goals. Myers remains perfect on field-goal tries, going 5-for-5 through four contests this season.

items.h: Myers made his only field-goal attempt, a 57 yarder, and all four of his extra-point tries in Sunday's 33-31 loss to the Commanders.
items.s: The veteran kicker remains perfect on the season, having now connected on all four field-goal tries and all nine extra-point attempts. The Seahawks are not doing much settling, but they are scoring, so Myers is getting enough chances to remain a strong fantasy play.

items.h: Myers converted his lone field-goal attempts and made all four PATs in Sunday's 31-7 win over the Cardinals.
items.s: Myers' field goal was good from 33 yards in the third quarter. Through two games, he's a perfect 3-for-3 on field goals and has made all five extra-point tries. Following a tumultuous preseason, Myers appears to have put his struggles behind him. He'll be a back-end K1 for next Sunday's road date with the Commanders.

items.h: Myers made both of his field-goal attempts as well as his sole PAT in Wednesday night's 13-10 victory over the Patriots.
items.s: Myers made field goals from 30 and 26 yards, nailing a fourth-quarter kick with just under six minutes remaining to take the game-winning lead. While Myers was perfect Wednesday night, the kicker was not truly tested in the contest and the preseason adversity could flare up if he must extend his range in future weeks.

items.h: Myers went 1-for-2 on field-goal attempts and missed his lone PAT in Friday's 9-9 preseason tie against the Chiefs.
items.s: Myers converted a 46-yard attempt in the first quarter but missed a PAT in the fourth quarter to keep Seattle's lead at 9-6. After the Chiefs tied the game, Myers missed an opportunity to give the Seahawks their only win of the preseason by pushing a 52-yard field-goal attempt wide right on the final play of the game. Myers missed his only field-goal attempt in Seattle's preseason opener against the Cowboys and went 1-for-2 on field-goal attempts while missing a PAT in the Seahawks' second preseason game. His preseason inaccuracy represents a significant departure from Myers' strong…

items.h: Myers missed his only field-goal attempt from 45 yards out and made his only extra-point try in the Seahawks' 17-7 preseason loss to the Cowboys on Saturday.
items.s: The veteran kicker's miss went wide right late in the first half at the end of a 15-play march. Myers is coming off a 2025 regular season during which he recorded new career highs in made field goals (41) and field-goal attempts (48), and he also tied a career best with nine makes from 50-plus yards. Despite Saturday's miss, Myers is fully expected to serve as Seattle's placekicker again this season.

items.h: As the coming season approaches, Myers is set to retain his role as the Seahawks' top kicker, Michael Hanich of SI.com reports.
items.s: In that role with the defending Super Bowl champions, Myers racked up a career high and league-leading 171 points in 2025, while making 41 of his 48 field-goal attempts and all 48 of his extra-point tries in 17 regular-season contests. Looking ahead to the coming campaign, the 35-year-old -- who currently is the only kicker on his team's roster -- should maintain a solid enough weekly floor working behind the Seahawks offense to maintain fantasy viability in 2026, even if he sees a modest reduction in terms of volume.

items.h: Myers connected on all five field-goal attempts and both extra-point tries in Sunday's 29-13 win over the Patriots in the Super Bowl.
items.s: Myers accounted for the Seahawks' first 12 points of the game, and he finished with 17 total points. The 34-year-old kicker completed a perfect postseason, drilling all eight field-goal attempts and 11 extra-point tries through three playoff games. Myers was dependable during the regular season, too, making 85 percent of his field goals and every extra point. He's heading into the final year of his contract but could be an extension candidate as the Seahawks look to retain their title in 2026.

items.h: Myers hit a 27-yard field goal and all four extra-point tries in Sunday's 31-27 win over the Rams in the NFC Championship Game.
items.s: Myers has hit all three field-goal attempts and all nine extra-point tries through two postseason games. During the regular season, he connected on 41 of 48 field-goal tries, including 22 of 27 (81.3 percent) from beyond 40 yards. The Seahawks will face the Patriots in the Super Bowl on Sunday, Feb. 8.

items.h: Myers connected on both field-goal attempts and all five extra-point tries in Saturday's 41-6 win over the 49ers in the divisional round.
items.s: Myers missed two kicks in the regular-season finale against the 49ers, but he was perfect in the rematch. Overall, Myers has hit 86 percent of his field-goal tries this season, including nine of 12 attempts from beyond 50 yards. Myers will be outdoors again in the NFC Championship Game regardless of the opponent.

items.h: Myers connected on two of four field-goal attempts and his lone extra-point try in Saturday's 13-3 win over the 49ers.
items.s: Myers struggled in this crucial divisional game, missing field goals from 47 and 26 yards, but the Seahawks' defense performed superbly to secure the first-round bye. The veteran kicker has now hit 41 of 48 field goals (85 percent) through 17 games, and he has drilled all 48 extra-point attempts. Myers has played in four playoff games with the Seahawks, connecting on five of seven field goals and all eight extra-point attempts.

items.h: Myers went 2-for-2 on field-goal tries and made all three of his PATs in Sunday's 27-10 win over the Panthers.
items.s: Myers was able to get back on track in Week 17 after going without a field-goal attempt in Week 16 against the Rams, making multiple field goals for the seventh time in eight games. The kicker converted a 48-yarder in the first quarter and a 30-yard try in the fourth quarter. Myers has had a masterful season, going 39-for-44 on field-goal attempts, including 9-for-12 from 50-plus yards, while making all 47 of his extra-point tries over 16 games.

items.h: Myers didn't attempt a field goal and made both PAT attempts in Thursday's 38-37 overtime win over the Rams.
items.s: The Seahawks couldn't afford to settle for field goals while trying to dig out of a 16-point fourth-quarter hole and went for two after each of their last three touchdowns. Myers had connected on at least three field-goal attempts in each of the previous six games, and he accounted for all 18 of Seattle's points in Week 15 with six field goals against the Colts. Thursday's ill-timed downturn could cost Myers' fantasy managers in the playoffs, but those that pull through can likely expect a bounce-back performance from one of the league's top kickers in Week 17 against the Panthers.

items.h: Myers went 6-for-6 on field-goal tries in Sunday's 18-16 win over the Colts.
items.s: Myers provided all of the offense for Seattle in Week 15, making field goals from 47 and 52 yards in the first half. He later added makes from 46, 32, 30 and 56 yards after the break, the last of which gave the Seahawks the lead with 18 seconds left in regulation. The kicker has now made at least three field goals in six consecutive contests, going 23-for-24 on field-goal attempts, including 5-for-6 from 50-plus yards, over that stretch.

items.h: Myers made all three of his field-goal tries and all four of his PATs in Sunday's 37-9 Week 14 win over Atlanta.
items.s: Myers' field-goal conversions came from 22, 48 and 37 yards out. The veteran kicker has made at least three field goals in five straight weeks, catapulting him into the top spot league-wide with 31 total FGs (on 36 attempts) on the campaign. Myers' surge has made him a top fantasy asset in leagues that include kickers.

items.h: Myers converted all four of his field-goal attempts and both extra-point tries in Sunday's 26-0 win over the Vikings.
items.s: Myers' field-goal makes came from 33, 56, 54 and 40 yards. He did the bulk of the scoring for Seattle against Minnesota, accounting for 14 of the team's 26 points. Myers has been on a hot streak, making 15 of 16 field-goal attempts and all 16 of his extra points in November. On the season, Myers is 28-for-33 on field goals and a perfect 38-for-38 on point-after tries. He's a premier fantasy kicker in Seattle's offense.

items.h: Myers made all three of his field-goal attempts and went 3-for-3 on extra-point tries during the Seahawks' 30-24 win over the Titans on Sunday.
items.s: Myers scored the Seahawks' first points of the game with a 47-yard field goal late in the first quarter before adding field goals from 30 and 36 yards in the second frame. He has made at least three field goals in each of his last three outings and five times this season. In the four games since Seattle's Week 8 bye, Meyers has gone 11-for-12 on field-goal attempts and has made all 14 of his point-after tries.

items.h: Myers went 4-for-5 on field-goal tries and made his only extra-point attempt in Sunday's 21-19 loss to the Rams.
items.s: Myers was the team's main offensive asset in Week 11, making field goals from 57, 30 and 22 yards in the first half before later adding a 29-yarder in the third quarter. The kicker was tasked with attempting a go-ahead field goal from 61 yards as time expired, but he missed it short. Myers has now connected on at least two field goals in four of his last five games and seven times overall this season. On the year, the kicker has gone 21-for-26 on field-goal attempts, including 6-for-9 from 50-plus yards, while making all 33 of his PATs over 10 contests.

items.h: Myers converted all three of his field-goal attempts and five of five extra-point tries in the Seahawks' 44-22 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
items.s: It marked Myers' second game this season making eight kicks, as Myers accounted for 14 points in total Sunday against Arizona. On the season, Myers has drilled 17 of 21 field-goal attempts and all 32 of his extra points. The veteran kicker will go on the road to face the Rams in Week 11.

items.h: Myers made his only field-goal attempt and went 5-for-5 on extra-point tries during Sunday night's 38-14 win over the Commanders.
items.s: Myers connected on a 41-yard field goal as time expired in the first half, notching at least one field goal for the third straight game and seventh contest overall this year. The kicker has now gone 14-for-18 on field-goal tries, including 4-for-6 from 50-plus yards, while making all 27 of his PATs over eight games this season.

items.h: Myers went 2-for-3 on field-goal attempts and made all three of his PATs in Seattle's win over the Texans on Monday.
items.s: Myers connected on kicks of 26 and 47 yards, while his third attempt was blocked by Denico Autry. The 34-year-old has not had an efficient start to the season, as he's converted on just 76.5 percent of his field-goal attempts but will look to have a bounce back performance following the team's upcoming bye week.

items.h: Myers went 2-for-2 on field-goal tries and made both of his PATs in Sunday's 20-12 win over the Jaguars.
items.s: Myers made field goals from 24 and 53 yards, getting back on track after missing his only field-goal try in Week 5. The kicker has now made multiple field goals in four of the team's six contests this year, and he'll look to continue to deliver on his opportunities in Week 7 versus Houston on Monday Night Football.

items.h: Myers missed his only field-goal attempt and went 5-for-5 on PATs in Sunday's 38-35 loss to the Buccaneers.
items.s: Myers missed a 44-yard field-goal try wide left in the first quarter, which proved to be his only opportunity to kick a field goal in Week 5. The kicker has now missed a field goal in three different contests this year, going 9-for-12 on field-goal attempts, including 3-for-4 from 50-plus yards, while making all 17 of his extra-point tries over five games this season.

items.h: Myers made three of four field-goal attempts, including a 52-yard game-winner as time expired, and both extra-point tries in Thursday's 23-20 win over the Cardinals.
items.s: The kicker rebounded as time expired after missing a 53-yard attempt with 3:21 to go in the fourth quarter. Myers also hit field goals from 44 and 31 yards, respectively. The veteran has now knocked home nine of 11 field-goal attempts and is 12-for-12 on extra-point tries in 2025.

items.h: Myers made all three of his field-goal attempts and all five of his extra-point tries in Sunday's 44-13 win over the Saints.
items.s: The kicker also connected on a season-high 56-yarder in the win. Myers is now six of seven on field-goal tries and 10 of 10 on extra-point attempts in 2025.

items.h: Myers connected on one of two field-goal attempts and made all four extra-point tries in Sunday's 31-17 win over the Steelers.
items.s: Myers hit the left upright on a 36-yard field-goal try in the second quarter, but he bounced back in the fourth quarter by drilling a 54-yarder. The veteran kicker was perfect from within 40 yards last season, and he should remain a stable kicking option moving forward.

items.h: Myers went 2-for-2 on field-goal attempts and made his lone extra-point try in Seattle's 17-13 loss to the 49ers on Sunday.
items.s: Myers' converted field goals were from 48 and 37 yards, and his lone extra point came after one-yard touchdown run by Zach Charbonnet. The 34-year-old Myers is in his seventh season with the Seahawks and is coming off a 2024 in which he made 26 of 30 field-goal attempts and 37 of his 40 extra points.

items.h: Myers connected on a 48-yard field goal and made two of three extra-point tries in Thursday's 23-23 tie versus the Raiders.
items.s: Last season, Myers hit 86.7 percent of his field-goal attempts, ranking 12th in the league among kickers who played at least 10 games. He also finished 24th by making 92.5 percent of his extra-point tries. Myers has been a mostly steady starter for the Seahawks, and he still has plenty of leg at 34 years old, as evidenced by a 59-yarder last season.

items.h: Myers connected on 26 of 30 field-goal attempts (86.7 percent) and 37 of 40 extra-point tries through 17 games during the 2024 season.
items.s: Myers' field-goal percentage ranked 12th in the league among kickers that played at least 10 games. The 33-year-old kicker also connected on nine of 12 field-goal tries from beyond 50 yards. Myers has two years remaining on his contract and should be secure as the Seahawks' starter in 2025.

items.h: Myers connected on both field-goal tries in Thursday's 6-3 win over the Bears.
items.s: Myers hit field goals from 27 and 50 yards to put together a perfect day in this low-scoring affair. The veteran kicker has hit 25 of 29 field-goal attempts (86 percent), including eight of 11 from 50 yards and beyond (72 percent). Myers will enjoy a dome atmosphere in the Week 18 matchup versus the Rams.

items.h: Myers went 1-for-2 on field-goal attempts and made all three of his extra-point tries during the Seahawks' 27-24 loss to the Vikings this past Sunday.
items.s: Myers connected on a 43-yard field goal early in the third quarter to tie the game at 17. He had another opportunity late in the fourth quarter to tie the game at 27, but his 60-yard field-goal attempt came up short. It was Myer's fourth missed field goal of the season and his first since Week 5 against the Giants. In the six games since the Seahawks' Week 10 bye, Myers has gone 11-for-12 on field-goal tries and 12-for-14 on extra-point attempts. He should have plenty of scoring opportunities Thursday against a Chicago defense that has given up 30 points in four of its last five games.

items.h: Myers connected on two field-goal attempts and his lone extra-point try in Sunday's 30-13 loss to the Packers.
items.s: Myers hit kicks from 45 and 48 yards, meaning he has now hit 13 of 16 kicks from beyond 40 yards (81.3 percent) and all nine tries from within 40 yards. He could struggle to get on the board in Week 16 against the Vikings, who have the league's fourth-ranked scoring defense.

items.h: Myers connected on all three field-goal attempts and all three extra-point tries in Sunday's 30-18 win over the Cardinals.
items.s: All three of Myers' field goals were from within 40 yards. He has been perfect within that range this season, although he has missed three of 33 extra-point attempts. Myers and the Seahawks will return home for a Week 15 matchup versus the Packers.

items.h: Myers hit both field-goal attempts and two of three extra-point tries in Sunday's 26-21 win over the Jets.
items.s: Myers connected on both kicks from beyond 40 yards, including a 54-yarder. However, he has now missed an extra-point try in three of the last four games. It hasn't been a determining factor in any of the games thus far. Myers has hit 11 of 14 kicks from beyond 40 yards this season. He'll enjoy a dome atmosphere in Week 14 versus the Cardinals.

items.h: Myers hit a 50-yard field goal but missed one of two extra-point tries in Sunday's 16-6 win over the Cardinals.
items.s: This was Myers' second missed extra point in three weeks, but he managed to connect on all three field-goal tries from beyond 50 yards in that stretch. He's been quite good from long distance this season and has hit 15 of 18 field-goal attempts through 11 games.

items.h: Myers hit both of his field-goal attempts and both extra-point tries in Sunday's 20-17 win over the 49ers.
items.s: Myers connected on kicks from 52 and 57 yards to mark a perfect game. He has now hit five of seven field-goal attempts from beyond 50 yards and 24 of 25 extra-point tries. Myers will look to stay hot in a home game versus the Cardinals in Week 12.

items.h: Myers made two of three extra-point tries in Sunday's 26-20 overtime loss to the Rams.
items.s: Myers had an extra point blocked in the second quarter, marking his first missed extra point since the 2022 season. He'll look to get back on track after the Seahawks' bye week when Seattle faces the 49ers in Week 11.

items.h: Myers connected on a 38-yard field goal and his lone extra-point try in Sunday's 31-10 loss to the Bills.
items.s: Myers remains perfect this season on kicks from within 40 yards, hitting all six of his field-goal tries and all 20 extra-point attempts. He has a decent opportunity ahead with a Week 9 matchup versus the Rams, who have given up 24.8 points per game, 11th most in the league.

items.h: Myers connected on two field-goal attempts and all four extra-point tries in Sunday's 34-14 win over the Falcons.
items.s: Myers drilled a 38-yarder on the opening drive and later hit a season-long 59-yard field goal in the fourth quarter. The veteran kicker has now hit six of nine field-goal tries from beyond 40 yards (67 percent) while making all 19 of his extra-point attempts.

items.h: Myers connected on a 20-yard field-goal attempt and all three extra-point tries in Thursday's 36-24 loss to the 49ers.
items.s: Myers made every kick for the first time since Week 2, but he wasn't really challenged in this outing. The veteran kicker hasn't missed an extra point since the 2022 season, and he has hit five of eight field-goal tries from beyond 40 yards.
